description_en: You can call ListServiceInstanceUpgradeHistory to query the upgrade history of a service instance
description_zh: 调用ListServiceInstanceUpgradeHistory查询服务实例升级信息
kebab_example: aliyun computenest list-service-instance-upgrade-history --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --max-results 20 --next-token BBBAAfu+XtuBE55iRLHEYYuojI4= --service-instance-id si-70a3b15bb62643xxxxxx --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListServiceInstanceUpgradeHistory

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page. Maximum value: 100. Default value: 20
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时，每页显示的行数。每页最大100行，默认为20行
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The token to retrieve the next page of results. Do not specify this parameter for the first request. For subsequent requests, specify the token returned in the previous request
parameters.help_zh: 是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：如果NextToken为空表示没有下一次查询。                                 如果NextToken有返回值，该取值表示下一次查询开始的令牌
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The ID of the service instance
parameters.name: service_instance_id
